messages:
ana_cs: pinging the team about MarlinFinance onboarding — PM flagged churn risk: mobile session drop & slower autocomplete. baseline median latency ~2.4s, 99p ~5.1s. theyre sensitive because renewal in 6 weeks.

ana_cs: attaching small set of user queries and a perf trace here: https://redwood.internal/traces/marlin/211009/trace-zip :eyes:

kai_se: thanks. quick read: lots of short requests (~<64 tokens) but hitting the full rwd-gpt-7b fp16 path. obvious opportunity: short-query routing + quantized 7b candidate.

noah_ie: agree. propose three-lever plan (low risk):
1) route tiny queries (<64 tokens) to rwd-mini-1 (cheap distil) with confidence threshold 0.85
2) introduce rwd-gpt-7b-int8 dynamic quant as primary for long queries
3) KV prefix caching for session tokens to reduce first-token latency

rachel_pm: that addresses latency + cost. what's the rollback and quality gating? MarlinFinance cares about precision on transactional prompts.

noah_ie: plan gating: run an eval of 1k recent prompts (mix of transactional + conversational) through int8 candidate + mini model. Metrics: intent accuracy, slot-filling F1, token-level perplexity. Threshold: intent acc drop <=0.8% absolute, slot-F1 delta <=1.2pp.

kai_se: canary plan: 3% traffic for 48h, region=us-east-1. fallback policy: immediate fallback to fp16 7b if confidence low or error spike. Alerting: 95p latency, intent-acc delta, and customer complaint tag.

ops-bot: capacity-check: us-east-1 spare GPUs: 8. recommend batch-size=3 to keep p50 stable.

noah_ie: sample redwoodctl route config Ill put in the ticket:
```bash
redwoodctl routes create --account marlinfinance --name mf-performance-canary \
  --policy "canary=3,region=us-east-1,model=rwd-gpt-7b-int8" \
  --short-route "threshold=64,model=rwd-mini-1,confidence=0.85" \
  --fallback "rwd-gpt-7b-fp16" --batch-size 3
```

kai_se: add eval harness step BEFORE canary: run diff eval on 1k prompts. eval-bot: please queue 1k sample job and report delta.

eval-bot: queued job 4521. expected runtime ~2h. will post summary to /evals/marlin/4521 when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana_cs: customer comms: i'll propose a 2-hour launch window next Wednesday morning. also ask them for 10-15 high-priority transaction prompts to seed the eval set.

rachel_pm: for renewal risk: note in the account doc that were proposing an immediate perf pilot; if we hit targets (p50 down >=20%, 95p down >=25%) we expect to reduce customer risk. i'll loop in AM for renewal.

noah_ie: small ops note: int8 quant path uses dynamic-quant fallback on OOM; add model param: quant_fallback=true in rollout. snippet:
```yaml
model_options:
  quant_mode: dynamic-int8
  quant_fallback: true
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    prefix: session_id
```

kai_se: i'll prepare enablement doc for MarlinFinance support team (how to read alerts, opt-out). also prepare a short script for local comparison so their SREs can reproduce.

ana_cs: thanks all. tagging @marlin-success-team — plan to update once eval-bot posts results. keeping this thread as the single source for the canary checklist. :white_check_mark:

eval-bot: job 4521 complete. brief: int8 median latency -22%, 95p -28%. intent acc delta -0.5pp, slot-F1 delta -0.7pp. full report: https://redwood.internal/evals/4521/report

ana_cs: great numbers. next steps: schedule canary with ops for Wed 09:00-11:00 EDT, send customer note with opt-out & rollback criteria.

rachel_pm: i'll add this to renewal playbook and flag as "positive win" if canary holds 72h.

noah_ie: i'll roll the route to 3% prod canary in the window and monitor. will post timestamp when started.

ops-bot: prod canary preflight OK. slack alert: create #mf-canary-alerts channel for post-deploy.

ana_cs: closing for now; will reopen with live rollout updates.
